description: Browser-based admin tool to photograph ~100 paintings quickly and consistently: fixed camera position, type a title, select 4 corners with a magnifier, perspective-correct to a perfect rectangle, derive real size via calibration.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: A constant camera distance makes pixel size proportional to real size, so one calibration serves all paintings
Precise manual corners give a clean crop and accurate size without fragile automatic edge detection

supportingConnections.reflection: Warp runs in plain TS on the bridge (no OpenCV dependency); output aspect uses the real cm size.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: One manual measurement per session yields real cm sizes for all paintings within a few % error
Remote capture without touching the camera keeps the position constant (so calibration stays valid) and makes each capture a single click

supportingConnections.reflection: Variants are generated by the bridge right after the warp, so a capture publishes all sizes in one step.
